verdict_rationale: All required data sources are present in the ClickHouse catalog: 13F holdings (Thomson Reuters s34), CRSP stock data, Compustat fundamentals, NAICS codes via CRSP/Compustat header tables. Coverage spans the paper's full sample period (1984-2021). The data verification is READY in terms of source coverage. The computational scope reduction (sub-period + sub-sample) is recorded in scope_reduction_target below and tracked in preparations/assumptions.md.

requirements.description: Thomson Reuters 13F institutional holdings (s34) with manager numbers, CUSIPs, holdings, and AUM
Manager names, typecodes, and country for rigid/dynamic classification
Aggregated holding data by (mgrno, cusip, fdate)
CRSP daily stock file (returns, prices, shares outstanding, exchcd)
CRSP monthly stock file (returns, prices, shares outstanding)
CRSP PIT header with shrcd, exchcd, NAICS for universe filter
Compustat annual fundamentals for book equity, OP, investment
CRSP-Compustat link table for CUSIP/permno/gvkey linkage

computed_columns_required.name: beta
computed_columns_required.formula: Cov(log(1+R_i), M) / Var(M) over 6 months (~126 trading days)

computed_columns_required.name: operating_profitability
computed_columns_required.formula: (revt - cogs - xsga - xint) / be  per FF2015

computed_columns_required.name: investment
computed_columns_required.formula: (capx_t / capx_{t-1}) - 1 OR total assets growth per FF2015

computed_columns_required.name: idiosyncratic_variance
computed_columns_required.formula: var(log(1+R)) - beta^2 * var(log(1+M)) over past 126 days

scope_reduction_reason: Paper requires SCQR estimation across 247,997 institution × quarter pairs (Section 5). Each SCQR = ~100 LP solves (descending grid). Total: ~25M LP solves. At even 1s/LP, this is 250+ days of single-thread compute. Within a single replication session, this is infeasible.

scope_reduction_target.sub_period: 2010Q1 to 2021Q4 (most data-rich 12 years; most stable methodology)
scope_reduction_target.sub_sample: Top 100 dynamic institutions by AUM (preserves economic content while reducing compute 1000x)
scope_reduction_target.estimated_compute: ~25K LP solves = several hours of compute

paper_evidence_for_scope_reduction: Section 5: 'The main empirical results in Section 6 require the SCQR method to be applied to 247,997 institution × date pairs.' Section 4.1: 'I estimate institutional demand for common stocks in each quarter' from 1984Q4-2021Q4 (149 quarters × ~1660 institutions = 247K).
